verses.text: I have summoned you by name; you are mine.
verses.title: God Knows Your Name

verses.text: A Living Sacrifice Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.
For he has rescued us from the dominion of darkness and brought us into the kingdom of the Son he loves
